confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Guanajuato's price levels for July 2026. No live booking pages or current listings were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation anchors, which vary by neighborhood and season. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the local beer price relationship.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Mexican colonial and university cities with domestic tourism, such as Puebla, Oaxaca, and Querétaro, adjusted to Guanajuato's centro histórico. Priced below San Miguel de Allende and above small provincial towns.
